answers.answer: Crafted link phrases are the densest and most context-specific pointer type because they characterize a target in relation to the surrounding argument. Their availability is unreliable because they require human judgment and authoring discipline; if no one writes the link or its context phrase, the pointer is absent or weak.

The four forms are natural-language, symbolic, distributed-parametric, and mixed. Representational form describes how an artifact’s operative part is encoded and consumed, whereas storage substrate describes where or in what container it is stored. For example, Markdown may contain natural-language, symbolic, or mixed content, while a vector store may expose natural-language records whose retrieval relies on distributed-parametric embeddings.

The best configuration—subtask-level tips with LLM-guided retrieval—reported a +14.3 percentage-point improvement in scenario goal completion on held-out AppWorld tasks. The KB analysis says the learning signal depends on a narrow, clear task-completion oracle; domains such as open-ended knowledge work, creative tasks, or advisory work lack an equivalent signal, so the approach cannot be adopted as-is.
